description.zh: 应用ID，通过控制台创建和查询，仅支持传单个ID。
description.en: The ID of the application. Create and find the application ID in the console. Only a single ID is supported.

description.zh: 已存在的频道ID，仅支持传单个ID。
description.en: The ID of an existing channel. Only a single ID is supported.

description.zh:
裁剪方式。取值：
- **1**：保持比例裁剪。
- **2**：保持比例留边。
- **3**：拉伸铺满。
description.en:
The clipping mode. Valid values:

- **1**: Clips the stream while maintaining the aspect ratio.

- **2**: Scales the stream proportionally and adds black borders.

- **3**: Stretches the stream to fill the entire layout.

description.zh:
布局生成用户指定列表，包括黑/白名单两种。

白名单，指定订阅房间里哪些用户视频流。
* 设置后自动填充根据该列表进行顺序填充
* 模版多布局切换时只计算白名单中的人

黑名单，指定不订阅房间里哪些用户视频流。
* 模版多布局切换时只计算非黑名单中的人
description.en:
The list of users for the layout. This list can act as a whitelist or a blacklist.

Whitelist: Lists the user video streams to subscribe to in the channel.

- After you configure the whitelist, auto-fill populates panes in the order shown in this list.

- When switching between multiple layouts in a template, only users in the whitelist are used.

Blacklist: Lists the user video streams not to subscribe to in the channel.

- When switching between multiple layouts in a template, only users not in the blacklist are used.

description.zh: 单元格设置，做多设置16个。
description.en: The cell settings. Configure up to 16 cells.
The global background color for panes.

description.zh: 指定需要被混音的用户列表。
description.en: The list of users whose audio to mix.

description.zh: 本次旁路推流的任务ID，仅支持传单个ID。由大小写字母、数字、下划线、短划线（-）组成，最大55字节。
description.en: The ID of the bypass stream ingest task. Only a single ID is supported. The ID can contain uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, underscores (\_), and hyphens (-). The maximum length is 55 bytes.

description.zh:
模版ID。
><notice>更新模版ID，仅可以更新布局，不支持更新分辨率。></notice>
description.en:
The template ID.
><notice>When you update the template ID, you can update only the layout. You cannot update the resolution.></notice>

title.en: Update a bypass stream ingest job

descriptions.zh:
### 使用说明
本接口用于更新在线频道旁路推流任务。

### QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
### Usage notes

This API updates a bypass stream ingest task for an online channel.

### QPS limits

The queries per second (QPS) limit for a single user is 10 calls per second. If you exceed this limit, API calls are subject to rate limiting. This may affect your business. Call this API at a reasonable rate.
